summary: Beth Skelley, 56, of Lafayette died when a tree fell on her tent late Monday night on the Colorado Trail just under Grizzly Peak, northwest of Engineer Mountain, while hiking with two friends (unharmed); San Juan County and La Plata County SAR responded with Flight for Life air support, revival attempts failed, and her remains were transported out Tuesday.
location: Colorado Trail, just under Grizzly Peak NW of Engineer Mountain
responding_agency: San Juan County SAR; La Plata County SAR; Flight for Life (Mercy Medical Center)
notes: 2019-08-12 = Monday (weekday-verified); incident date per San Juan County SO statement; mined run 809 SnowBrains chunk.
